name: trio-sync
description: Lets Claude chat, Claude Code, and Cowork hand off context on any project via a shared .trio/ folder (STATUS.md, LEDGER.md, TO_CODE.md, FROM_CODE.md, DIALOGUE.md), so each surface knows what the others already did, asked, or answered. Adds DIALOGUE.md rotation, a 'resolved' convention for TO_CODE/FROM_CODE, an optional public-GitHub channel (CHAT_LINKS.md) for Chat, and folder discovery so Cowork finds a project's device-bridge folder itself.
